climate_pressure: Drought and climate-related disasters that reduce nearby water/fuel availability.
documented_impact: Longer collection journeys and greater unpaid care demands for rural women and girls.
fcv_mediator: Gendered allocation of domestic work, poverty and unequal access to assets/protection constrain safe alternatives.
possible_consequence: The CCDR describes heightened harassment/sexual-assault exposure and lost educational/economic opportunities; no estimated climate-attributable incidence.
alternative_explanations: Pre-existing gender inequality, poverty, protection-service availability and violence independently affect safety.
uncertainty: Conditional mechanism in 2025 CCDR synthesis, not event-level attribution, a village-specific finding or a measured rise in violence. Not independently reverified in the 27 October 2026 remediation; check the cited passage before relying on this claim.
resilience_factors: The report recommends gender-responsive disaster planning and locally inclusive institutions; effectiveness remains unevaluated.
compact_statement: The Gabon CCDR describes how drought/disaster-related collection burdens can expose rural women and girls to protection risks through gendered work and constrained safe alternatives; this is a conditional mechanism, not an incidence estimate.
